# CompressTo20KB
> Free online image compressor — reduce any image to a target file size (20KB, 50KB, 100KB, 200KB) instantly in your browser. No upload to server, no signup required.

## What this site does
CompressTo20KB compresses JPEG, PNG, and WebP images to a specific file size target directly in the browser using WebAssembly. No files are sent to any server. Supports bulk compression and ZIP download.

## Key pages
- / — Main image compressor (compress to 20KB)
- /compress-to-50kb — Compress image to 50KB
- /compress-to-100kb — Compress image to 100KB
- /compress-to-200kb — Compress image to 200KB
- /bulk-image-compressor — Compress multiple images at once
- /batch-image-compressor-zip — Compress batch and download as ZIP
- /compress-for-amazon — Compress images for Amazon product listings
- /compress-for-etsy — Compress images for Etsy listings
- /blog/how-to-compress-image-for-email — Guide: compress images for email

## Who this is for
Anyone who needs to reduce image file size to a specific KB target: visa applications, job applications, online forms with file size limits, e-commerce product photos, email attachments, and web optimization.

## Technical
All compression happens client-side via WebAssembly. Supported formats: JPEG, PNG, WebP. Output: JPEG. Privacy: zero data sent to servers.
